北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友们，气温 3℃，体感有些冷，记得添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it's 3℃ but feels colder. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪中雨，气温 6℃ 体感 0℃，注意防雨保暖，别着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi, moderate rain and 6℃ (feels like 0℃). Stay dry and warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海细雨绵绵，气温 5℃，体感微凉，出门别忘带伞哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai, light rain and 5℃. It's a bit chilly, don't forget your umbrella!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，气温 23℃ 很舒适，注意室内通风，保持好心情！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and a comfy 23℃. Keep good ventilation and a good mood!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光正好，气温 25℃，出门记得防晒补水，享受好天气！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and 25℃. Remember sunscreen and hydration, enjoy the day!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴沉，气温 5℃ 略显湿冷，请注意防寒，保持干燥哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and 5℃, a bit damp and cold. Stay warm and dry!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京雨夹雪，气温 3℃ 体感 -2℃，天寒地滑，出行务必小心！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has sleet, 3℃ (feels like -2℃). Roads are slippery, please be careful!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 12℃ 适中，早晚温差大，别忘了添衣哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and 12℃. Big temperature difference, add layers if needed!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷，气温 3℃ 但体感 -5℃，风力大，务必多穿防寒服！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and 3℃ but feels like -5℃, windy. Dress very warmly!
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，气温 3℃，体感微凉，多喝热水，注意保暖防寒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and 3℃, a bit chilly. Drink hot water, keep warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，气温 13℃ 比较舒适，注意添减衣物，保持愉快！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and a pleasant 13℃. Adjust your clothing, stay cheerful!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天晴，气温 -8℃ 体感 -15℃！请务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but -8℃ (feels like -15℃)! Bundle up completely, prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，气温 -4℃ 体感 -9℃，虽有阳光，也要注意防寒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but -4℃ (feels like -9℃). Though sunny, keep warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，气温 13℃ 宜人，户外活动很舒适，心情棒棒！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and a pleasant 13℃. Enjoy outdoor activities, feel great!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，气温 18℃，湿度大，穿着舒适，保持好心情哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and 18℃, high humidity. Dress comfortably, keep smiling!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，气温 1℃ 体感 -7℃，风大寒冷，别忘了防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, 1℃ (feels like -7℃), windy and cold. Stay warm and windproof!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴天，气温 -1℃ 体感 -6℃，风大干燥，注意保湿防风。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, -1℃ (feels like -6℃), windy and dry. Moisturize and stay windproof!
